paper_id: Solving Pictorial Jigsaw Puzzle by Stigmergy-inspired Internet-based Human Collective Intelligence
title: Solving Pictorial Jigsaw Puzzle by Stigmergy-inspired Internet-based Human Collective Intelligence
motivation: 利用蚂蚁通过环境间接协调的stigmergy机制，在网络空间实现分布式人类玩家的集体智能
problem_framing: 将拼图问题建模为无法自顶向下分解的复杂问题，需要用EIF循环在网络空间模拟stigmergy
key_insight: 用软件算法替代物理定律作为整合机制，用集体意见图COG+个体探索结果的组合替代物理位置作为反馈基础
method_signature: EIF循环(探索-整合-反馈)驱动COG持续更新实现网络空间stigmergy
evaluation_criteria: 拼图解决时间随玩家数量呈近线性反比、可扩展性、对最佳单人的提升幅度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 我们的目标不是证明方法能胜过自动求解器，而是展示人类在适当组织下拥有机器无法替代的独特能力
evidence_for_taste: the kind of complex problems that are embodied by jigsaw puzzle in general
human beings, if being organized appropriately, do possess some distinctive capabilities
the integration in EIF is not carried out by physical laws as in physical-space based stigmergy

no need to pre-decompose the to-be-resolved problem
